D: The Grinch plans to steal Christmas from Whoville after the town decides to make it three times bigger.
P: Serve the main when the Grinch sits down at the Whos' table.
S: Grinch green spinach and herb dip
Spinach, avocado, basil and yoghurt dip with pita chips and cucumber

A bright green dip of spinach, avocado, Greek yoghurt and fresh herbs, served with crunchy pita chips and cucumber sticks. Blanch 100g baby spinach in boiling water for 20 seconds, drain and squeeze dry. Blitz with 1 avocado, 200g Greek yoghurt, a handful each of basil and parsley, 1 small garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt until smooth and very green. Cut 4 pita breads into wedges, brush with oil and bake at 190C for 8 minutes until crisp. Serve the dip with the pita chips and cucumber sticks.
Cob loaf stuffed with garlic butter and melted cheese

A crusty cob loaf cut into a grid and stuffed with garlic butter, mozzarella and chives, baked until gooey for pulling apart. Cut a 500g cob loaf in a criss-cross pattern every 2cm, without cutting through the base. Melt 80g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp chopped chives. Spoon the butter into the cuts, then stuff with 200g grated mozzarella and 40g grated parmesan. Wrap in foil and bake at 180C for 15 minutes, then unwrap and bake 10 minutes more until golden and melted. Pull apart at the table.
M: Whoville roast beast with crispy potatoes
Garlic rosemary beef sirloin roast with crisp roast potatoes

Garlic and herb crusted roast beef carved at the table, with crunchy duck fat potatoes, honey roast carrots and a rich red gravy. Rub a 1.5kg beef sirloin roast with 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, oil and salt. Parboil 1.2kg quartered potatoes for 8 minutes, drain, rough up and toss in 3 tbsp duck fat. Roast the potatoes at 200C for 50 minutes and the beef for 50 minutes for medium rare, adding 4 carrots tossed in honey for the last 35. Rest the beef 15 minutes. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices with 400ml beef stock to make gravy.
W: Steamed Christmas pudding with warm vanilla custard

Warm steamed Christmas pudding in wedges with vanilla custard, a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a sprinkle of red and green sprinkles. Steam an 800g Christmas pudding in its basin over simmering water for 1 hour, or follow the packet. Warm 500ml milk and 100ml cream. Whisk 4 egg yolks with 60g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour, pour in the hot milk while whisking, then return to the pan and stir over low heat until thick. Add 1 tsp vanilla. Turn out the pudding, cut into wedges and serve with custard, ice cream and a few Christmas sprinkles.
K: Frothy milk chocolate with whipped cream and green sprinkles

Frothy hot chocolate made with real chocolate, topped with whipped cream, green sprinkles and a dusting of cocoa. Heat 1L full cream milk with 1 tbsp caster sugar until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped milk chocolate and 1 tbsp cocoa until melted and frothy, or blitz with a stick blender for extra froth. Pour into 4 mugs. Whip 150ml thickened cream with 1 tsp icing sugar, spoon on top and finish with green sprinkles and a little cocoa dusted over.

dishes.n: Grinch green spinach and herb dip
dishes.make_ahead: Make the dip up to 2 days ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; bake the pita chips up to 3 days ahead, airtight

steps.text: Blanch the spinach in boiling water briefly, drain and squeeze dry.
Blitz with the avocado, yoghurt, basil, parsley, garlic, lemon juice and salt until smooth and very green.
Cut the pita into wedges, brush with oil and bake at 190C until crisp.
Serve the dip with the pita chips and cucumber sticks.

dishes.make_ahead: Stuff and wrap in foil up to 1 day ahead and keep it in the fridge; bake on the night and add 10 minutes

steps.text: Cut the loaf in a criss-cross pattern without cutting through the base.
Melt the butter with the garlic and chives and spoon it into the cuts.
Stuff the cuts with mozzarella and parmesan and wrap in foil.
Bake at 180C, then unwrap and bake until golden and melted.
Pull apart at the table.

dishes.n: Whoville roast beast with crispy potatoes
dishes.make_ahead: Rub the beef up to 1 day ahead and keep it in the fridge, and parboil the potatoes up to 1 day ahead; roast and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Rub the beef with the garlic, rosemary, oil and salt.
Parboil the potatoes, drain, rough up and toss in duck fat.
Roast the potatoes at 200C and the beef for medium rare, adding the carrots tossed in honey for the last part.
Rest the beef.
Whisk the flour into the pan juices with the stock and simmer to make gravy.

veg.n: Whoville roast beast loaf with crispy potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Loaf can be shaped 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms with the garlic and rosemary in the olive oil until dry, then mix with the lentils, walnuts, breadcrumbs and eggs and press into a lined loaf tin.
Parboil the potatoes, drain, rough up and toss in the vegetable oil.
Roast the potatoes and the loaf at 200C, adding the carrots tossed in honey for the last part.
Rest the loaf.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the stock and soy and simmer to make gravy.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the custard up to 1 day ahead with cling film pressed on the surface and reheat gently; steam the pudding on the night

steps.text: Steam the pudding in its basin over simmering water, or follow the packet.
Warm the milk and cream.
Whisk the yolks with the sugar and cornflour, pour in the hot milk while whisking, then return to the pan.
Stir over low heat until thick, then add the vanilla.
Turn out the pudding, cut into wedges and serve with custard, ice cream and sprinkles.

dishes.make_ahead: Whip the cream up to 4 hours ahead and keep it chilled; heat the milk and whisk in the chocolate just before serving

steps.text: Heat the milk with the sugar until steaming.
Whisk in the chocolate and half the cocoa until melted and frothy, or blitz with a stick blender.
Pour into mugs.
Whip the cream with the icing sugar, spoon on top and finish with green sprinkles and the remaining cocoa dusted over.
